'''Joan Aitor Osorio Marti'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Osorio|Marti}} (born 31 October 1975) is an [[Andorra]]n swimmer who competed at the [[1996 Summer Olympics]].<ref>{{cite Sports-Reference |title=Aitor Osorio |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/os/aitor-osorio-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161203182206/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/os/aitor-osorio-1.html |archive-date=3 December 2016 |accessdate=3 December 2017}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Osorio was 20 years old when he represented his country at the [[1996 Summer Olympics]]. He competed in the [[Swimming at the 1996 Summer Olympics – Men's 200 metre butterfly|200 metre butterfly]] event. He swam his heat in 2:12.59 minutes and finished 42nd overall, so he didn't qualify for the finals.<ref>{{cite web |title=Atlanta 1996: Swimming – Men's 200m Butterfly Heats |url=http://library.la84.org/6oic/OfficialReports/1996/1996v3p1.pdf |work=[[1996 Summer Olympics|Atlanta 1996]] |publisher=[[LA84 Foundation]] |page=47 |accessdate=3 December 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181007203902/http://library.la84.org/6oic/OfficialReports/1996/1996v3p1.pdf |archive-date=7 October 2018 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

Osorio would later become the president of the [[Andorran Swimming Federation]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Aitor Osorio |url=https://www.elperiodic.ad/entrevista/58443/aitor-osorio-jo-prohibiria-les-quintades-tenen-un-punt-dhumiliacio |website=elperiodic.ad |accessdate=3 December 2017}}</ref>
